about: RH2 (Volter's product) keeps its authority store in a Supabase project's Postgres, which it reaches over the Postgres wire alone: no PostgREST, no Supabase client library, no anon session (apps/rh2/docs/OPERATIONS.md:255-258 at 34fdc93). The World makes the project and hands its database's URL to RH2; on Monday 5 January RH2's Worker finds the fresh database unmigrated, the operator's --declare-distributed-authority command migrates it to schema 106 (RH2's migrate step, apps/rh2/src/database/migrate-cli.ts, with --declare-distributed-authority, as its header prescribes for a fresh database) and the Worker finds it ready; a week later the release finds the schema current and runs its --complete-work-cutover migrate, which finds the Task copy already complete. Every statement is RH2's own, in the order and shape its code sends it on its one migration connection (pool max 1, apps/rh2/src/database/pool-options.ts:16), each step naming the line that sends it; Postgres's answers are the World's database's, stamped by the World clock.

CREATE FUNCTION public.rh2_enforce_authority_job_state() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
      BEGIN
        IF NEW.job_authority = 'distributed'
          AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.state->'jobs') > 0 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'distributed Job authority cannot retain aggregate Jobs'
            USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END IF;
        IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
          AND NEW.job_authority <> OLD.job_authority
          AND (
            jsonb_array_length(NEW.state->'jobs') > 0
            OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
                FROM rh2_jobs AS job
               WHERE job.authority_id = NEW.authority_id
            )
          ) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'Job authority cannot change while Jobs exist'
            USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END
      $$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.rh2_enforce_normalized_job_authority() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
      DECLARE
        declared_authority text;
        target_authority_id text;
      BEGIN
        target_authority_id := CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN OLD.authority_id ELSE NEW.authority_id END;
        SELECT authority.job_authority
          INTO declared_authority
          FROM rh2_authorities AS authority
         WHERE authority.authority_id = target_authority_id
         FOR SHARE;
        IF declared_authority IS DISTINCT FROM 'distributed' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'normalized Jobs require distributed Job authority'
            USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END IF;
        IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
          RETURN OLD;
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END
      $$;
